name: Life Control — Anna Edition
tagline: Privacy-first goals, tasks, money, learning and consent-based AI weekly reviews.
description: Life Control — Anna Edition is an independent personal-growth workspace built for Anna. Manage tasks and due-date reminders inside the app, record income and expenses, log learning sessions, journal privately, and forecast a savings goal. An AI-powered weekly review is only sent when you explicitly approve a request and select the data categories to share. The AI never receives excluded categories. Your records are stored in Anna's per-app storage, not synced from the original Android Room database. This initial edition does not provide system push notifications, live Android sync, or automatic financial forecasts based on bank transactions.
